title: Krishna Gaadi Veera Prema Gaadha
desc: Krishna falls in love with Mahalakshmi whose brother is a henchman of a don. During a gang war, he entrusts the responsibility of children to Krishna and asks him to return them to their parents.

title: To Let
desc: A family of three faces hardship as they desperately search for a new rental home after their landlady demands they leave their current house.

title: Pisasu
desc: Upon witnessing the death of a young girl in an accident, Siddharth, a violinist, begins to feel a supernatural presence in his house. The mystery begins to unfold when he meets the girl's father.

title: Bhoomi
desc: Bhoominathan, a NASA scientist, helps his village people against the evil corporations.

title: Minnal Murali
desc: Jaison, a young tailor, gains superpowers after being struck by lightning. However, he must thwart the evil intentions of an unexpected adversary to become the superhero that his rural village needs.

title: Action
desc: Subhash, an army man, seeks vengeance when a conspiracy claims his loved ones. He investigates the plot and takes matters into his own hands, mounting a daring operation to capture the culprit.

title: Lucifer
desc: The demise of the leader of a political party leads to a massive power struggle. Amidst the chaos, a mystical man named Stephen comes in to ascend the throne.

title: Velai Illa Raja
desc: A young man decides to protect his uncle from his nefarious enemy and put an end to his tyranny.

title: Kadhalar Kudiyiruppu
desc: A man aids his friend's son in becoming a police officer, but complications arise when his daughter falls in love with the new recruit and urges elopement.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Gouravam
desc: Arjun reaches his friend Shanmughan's village, only to find out that he has eloped with Pasupathy's daughter. So, Arjun, along with his friends and Yazhini, a lawyer, sets out to find the couple.

title: NGk
desc: Nandha Gopalan Kumaran, a social worker, is forced to join politics to help his village. He faces various obstacles while learning the tricks to survive in power.

title: Ethir Neechal
desc: When a man's deception about his real name is revealed, he is compelled to join a marathon to prove himself to his lover.

title: Ramleela-Govindudu Andariva
desc: Upset that his son wants to settle in London, Balaraju has a bitter argument with him. Later, his grandson travels to India to mend the relationship between his father and grandfather.

title: Petromax
desc: Saravanan, an Indian living abroad, struggles to sell his ancestral home in India due to the supposed presence of ghosts in it. He devises a plan to prove that his house is not haunted.

title: Chithha
desc: Living a quiet life with his niece, Eeswaran manages to provide for her and nurtures her like a parent. However, his journey takes an insidious turn when she goes missing.

title: Hello
desc: A man finds and stores the contact number of his lost childhood love in his phone, which is then stolen by a mafia thug. He then sets out to retrieve the cellphone at all costs.
